# Ebda (ابدأ)

> Ebda is a self-serve online store builder for sellers in Egypt, built by Whisky 11 (https://whisky11.com). Arabic-first (RTL) with English. Merchants sign up, build and run their own store; every store gets a free <slug>.ebda.app address and can attach a custom domain.

Pricing (EGP per month): Basic 1,490, Growth 3,490, Business 9,990; yearly billing saves 25%; 14-day free Growth trial; 0% commission on orders on every plan. Full plan comparison (orders, team, stores, abandoned carts, branding, API/MCP, analytics, support) is on the home page.

## Pages
- [Home (Arabic, Egyptian colloquial)](https://ebda.app/): store story, the five templates, features, payments and shipping, pricing and plan comparison, FAQ
- [Home (English)](https://ebda.app/en/): the same in English
- [Legal notice](https://ebda.app/legal/)
- [Privacy policy](https://ebda.app/privacy/)
- [Terms of service](https://ebda.app/terms/)
- [Merchant agreement](https://ebda.app/merchant-agreement/)
- [Acceptable use](https://ebda.app/acceptable-use/)

## Facts
- Templates: Souq (electronics), Dahab (jewellery), Qamar (fashion), Lamma (home food), Jasmine (beauty), edited in a visual page builder.
- Payments: cash on delivery, InstaPay, and card/wallet payments through Paymob, Kashier and FawryPay.
- Shipping: Bosta, ShipBlu, Mylerz and Aramex, or the merchant's own delivery.
- Also: AI product descriptions and Arabic/English translation, VAT for registered merchants, a dashboard installable on the phone with order notifications, analytics, wa.me WhatsApp order buttons.
- Sign up: https://admin.ebda.app/signup
- Contact: hello@ebda.app; security reports: security@ebda.app
